concerns.text: Task T009 (Power Analysis) is scheduled AFTER T011 (Source Verification/Download). Spec FR-007 and US-4 mandate power analysis run 'BEFORE any data ingestion' to gate the study. T009 violates this by placing the gate after the ingestion step, allowing potential ingestion of underpowered data.

Tasks T013-T018 (Ingestion/Preprocessing) lack explicit 'Primary Mode' gating. Spec FR-001 and US-1 require the pipeline to terminate immediately in 'Data Insufficient Mode' if no paired dataset is found. These tasks imply execution of ingestion logic even when the mode flag is 'Data Insufficient', violating the termination constraint.

Tasks T023-T039b (US2/US3 Modeling & Validation) are listed as implementation tasks without explicit 'Primary Mode' conditional execution. Spec FR-004, FR-005, and US-2/US-3 state these steps 'ONLY execute in Primary Mode' and must be skipped entirely in 'Data Insufficient Mode'. The task list fails to encode this hard constraint, risking generation of forbidden artifacts.

Task T050 (Independent Dataset Evaluation) is listed as a dependent task after T038. Spec FR-020 and Constitution Principle VII require this check to be conditional on the primary dataset being sufficient. The task description does not explicitly state that this step must be skipped if the primary pipeline terminated in 'Data Insufficient Mode' or 'Underpowered' mode, violating the conditional execution constraint.

Task T016 requires generating 'docs/research_results.md' to report dataset flags. Spec Edge Cases and FR-001 state that in 'Data Insufficient Mode', the system must NOT generate claims or final research reports, only a manifest and termination log. T016 violates the constraint against generating results in this mode.
